messages.context: Mayor Marina 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: I love diving and fishing. The world is much simpler when you live on the beach.
messages.text: I love diving and fishing. The world is much simpler when you live on the beach.
messages.zh: 我喜欢潜水和钓鱼。住在海滩上,世界会简单得多。

messages.context: Mayor Marina 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: If you don't like the sea, don't vote for me.
messages.text: If you don't like the sea, don't vote for me.
messages.zh: 如果你不喜欢大海,就别投我。

messages.context: Mayor Marina 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: I come from an atoll, the sea goes very deep there.
messages.text: I come from an atoll, the sea goes very deep there.
messages.zh: 我来自一座环礁,那里的海非常深。
